summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would bring forward public reporting of selected tax information for large corporate entities, applying the disclosure requirement from the 2012 to 2013 year.
It would apply to corporate entities whose total income is at least $100 million, with publication of the relevant information undertaken by the tax commissioner.
The change would amend the earlier tax transparency legislation and begin the day after royal assent, with the sponsor identifying greater transparency as its purpose.
changes: The first income year covered by the publication requirement would move back to 2012 to 2013.
The amendment would alter the Tax Laws Amendment (2013 Measures No. 2) Act 2013.
The amending Act would commence on the day following royal assent.
summary.affected: Corporate entities meeting the $100 million total income threshold and the tax commissioner are affected.
